title: 第2回「時は来た」と高市首相、憲法をどう変えたいのか　持論は「国防軍」
extracted_text: 「戦争反対」「高市政権は憲法を守れ」。国会前や各地で、憲法9条改正に反対するデモが行われています。「時は来た」と、改憲に突き進む高市政権の思惑と、9条が果たしてきた役割などを考えます。 「理想の日本国を文字にして、歴史という書物の新たなページに刻もう。そのページをめくるべきかどうか、国民に堂々と問おうではありませんか。立党から70年、時は来ました」 トランプ米大統領から、イラン攻撃に伴いホルムズ海峡への艦艇派遣を求められていたが、3月19日の日米首脳会談では応じなかった。その時に憲法に触れていたが、国会では「法律の範囲内で、できることとできないことを説明した」と答弁。「9条を盾にしたということはない」とも主張した。
translated_text: "Oppose War" "Takaichi Administration, Protect the Constitution." Demonstrations opposing the revision of Article 9 of the constitution are being held in front of the Diet and in various places. We examine the Takaichi administration's push for constitutional revision with its claim that "the time has come," as well as the role that Article 9 has played. "Let us inscribe the ideal Japan in文字 and carve it into a new page of the book of history. Should we turn that page? Should we not ask the people frankly? It has been 70 years since the party's founding — the time has come." U.S. President Trump had requested the dispatch of warships to the Strait of Hormuz following attacks on Iran, but Japan did not comply at the Japan-U.S. summit on March 19. At that time, he touched on the constitution, and in the Diet he responded, "Within the bounds of law, I explained what can and cannot be done." He also claimed, "This is not using Article 9 as a shield."
title_en: "The Time Has Come," Says PM Takaichi, Explaining How She Wants to Change Constitution — Her Proposal: "Defense Force"
